high_level_description: The image appears to be a screenshot of a webpage or article discussing linguistics, specifically the work of Noam Chomsky and the Chomskyan school of linguistics. The text is written in a clear, readable font and discusses Chomsky's research on syntactic theory as a paper-and-pencil theorist, noting that he did not conduct experiments on the psychological or neural bases of language comprehension. It also mentions that his ideas in linguistics are silent on the mechanisms underlying sentence processing and understanding.
